165bfdbf2855bda6eedfad942a4bfb28.name: Cishookandrbee synth
165bfdbf2855bda6eedfad942a4bfb28.en: Just four gliders build the cis-hook and R-bee.
165bfdbf2855bda6eedfad942a4bfb28.pt: Apenas quatro planadores constroem o cis-hook and R-bee.

088092421b265809a98c2d4cdb223e53.name: Confused eaters synth
088092421b265809a98c2d4cdb223e53.pt: Planadores em colisão montam o confused eaters.

088184209e43b71ab227ed85679fb0d9.name: Dart synth
088184209e43b71ab227ed85679fb0d9.en: Gliders collide to build the dart spaceship.
088184209e43b71ab227ed85679fb0d9.pt: Planadores colidem para construir a nave dart.

21bb672d2407dd700e8ffe2bb3604f0e.name: Duoplet synth
21bb672d2407dd700e8ffe2bb3604f0e.en: Gliders collide to leave a duoplet, which then vanishes: everything is gone by generation 21.
21bb672d2407dd700e8ffe2bb3604f0e.pt: Planadores colidem e deixam um duoplet, que logo desaparece: tudo some até a geração 21.

33fdf08294be472557733a69eecac211.name: Eaterheadsiameseeatertail synth
33fdf08294be472557733a69eecac211.en: A 4-glider recipe for eater head siamese eater tail, along with further recipes from Mark Niemiec's database.
33fdf08294be472557733a69eecac211.pt: Uma receita de 4 planadores para o eater head siamese eater tail, junto com outras do banco de dados de Mark Niemiec.

198d8772b4a6547cc4bbb5a030701fa8.name: Fheptomino synth
198d8772b4a6547cc4bbb5a030701fa8.en: Gliders collide to form an F-heptomino.
198d8772b4a6547cc4bbb5a030701fa8.pt: Planadores colidem para formar um F-heptomino.

8a200e79f4317872733fc46c3f1cb83d.name: Frenchkiss synth
8a200e79f4317872733fc46c3f1cb83d.en: A glider collision that builds the French kiss.
8a200e79f4317872733fc46c3f1cb83d.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que constrói o French kiss.

252a05363015db65d28fd4a6ed781850.name: Gosper glider gun synth
252a05363015db65d28fd4a6ed781850.en: Colliding gliders assemble a Gosper glider gun, which then starts firing gliders of its own.
252a05363015db65d28fd4a6ed781850.pt: Planadores colidem para montar um Gosper glider gun, que então passa a disparar seus próprios planadores.

0698ede783cd189aab5c8839eb42efc2.name: Heavyweight emulator synth
0698ede783cd189aab5c8839eb42efc2.en: Gliders collide to build the heavyweight emulator.
0698ede783cd189aab5c8839eb42efc2.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o heavyweight emulator.

14b2f21c37fd430a4be7277826d89aca.name: Honeythieves synth
14b2f21c37fd430a4be7277826d89aca.en: A glider collision that produces honey thieves.
14b2f21c37fd430a4be7277826d89aca.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que produz o honey thieves.

001746009d4466677c26b1250a883abe.name: Integral with hook synth
001746009d4466677c26b1250a883abe.en: Gliders collide to create an integral with hook.
001746009d4466677c26b1250a883abe.pt: Planadores colidem para criar um integral with hook.

015148d8d40d11998c75bc2f4c0055ec.name: Justyna synth
015148d8d40d11998c75bc2f4c0055ec.en: A glider collision that produces Justyna.
015148d8d40d11998c75bc2f4c0055ec.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que produz Justyna.

4fc53b2f2405b393cae8d653c3279d09.name: Lightweightemulator synth
4fc53b2f2405b393cae8d653c3279d09.en: Builds the lightweight emulator from 111 gliders; Martin Grant and Mark Niemiec both worked on it.
4fc53b2f2405b393cae8d653c3279d09.pt: Monta o lightweight emulator a partir de 111 planadores; Martin Grant e Mark Niemiec trabalharam na receita.

082d9b6236b13be31fcc44b70e431495.name: Long canoe synth
082d9b6236b13be31fcc44b70e431495.en: Several glider recipes that produce the long canoe.
082d9b6236b13be31fcc44b70e431495.pt: Várias receitas com planadores que produzem o long canoe.

3075f5528657a6fa59e3b525fa0ec083.name: long3boat synth
3075f5528657a6fa59e3b525fa0ec083.en: Only four gliders are needed to make the long^3 boat.
3075f5528657a6fa59e3b525fa0ec083.pt: Bastam quatro planadores para fazer o long^3 boat.

0c69f9fdcd134affe33a1493556cc166.name: Mazing synth
0c69f9fdcd134affe33a1493556cc166.pt: Planadores em colisão constroem o mazing.

4a477adfe19b602b08c2489280975298.name: Mold on fumarole synth
4a477adfe19b602b08c2489280975298.en: Twelve gliders collide to produce mold on fumarole.
4a477adfe19b602b08c2489280975298.pt: Doze planadores colidem para produzir o mold on fumarole.

084ed7ba63bdf9ab809379dd80fb5d6e.name: Octagon 2 synth
084ed7ba63bdf9ab809379dd80fb5d6e.en: A glider collision that yields octagon 2.
084ed7ba63bdf9ab809379dd80fb5d6e.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que gera o octagon 2.

081f9a859d25361a454982ca6f115827.name: p35honeyfarmhassler synth
081f9a859d25361a454982ca6f115827.en: Builds the p35 honey farm hassler from 19 gliders.
081f9a859d25361a454982ca6f115827.pt: Monta o p35 honey farm hassler com 19 planadores.

173e545947630d10837e3d872b8773b1.name: p60trafficlighthasslerpd synth
173e545947630d10837e3d872b8773b1.en: Thirty gliders assemble the p60 traffic light hassler in its PD version.
173e545947630d10837e3d872b8773b1.pt: Trinta planadores montam o p60 traffic light hassler na versão com PD.

2e8063b0d15a6f4faf7e6de6b5e3ece7.name: Pentoad synth
2e8063b0d15a6f4faf7e6de6b5e3ece7.en: Gliders collide to construct the pentoad.
2e8063b0d15a6f4faf7e6de6b5e3ece7.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o pentoad.

d39d3dd5893b173eaa4ee12fce359bcb.name: Pinwheel synth
d39d3dd5893b173eaa4ee12fce359bcb.en: A glider collision that builds the pinwheel.
d39d3dd5893b173eaa4ee12fce359bcb.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que constrói o pinwheel.

c683207ef5758063a77acb9943c882ed.name: Pressurecooker synth
c683207ef5758063a77acb9943c882ed.en: Gliders collide to assemble the pressure cooker.
c683207ef5758063a77acb9943c882ed.pt: Planadores colidem para montar o pressure cooker.

0c76d36f4e7f0ba18127c3e299b24d49.name: Quadpole synth
0c76d36f4e7f0ba18127c3e299b24d49.en: Five gliders are all it takes to build a quadpole.
0c76d36f4e7f0ba18127c3e299b24d49.pt: Cinco planadores bastam para construir um quadpole.

2800c96a52a7dc865f1aa44d7e410d61.name: Schick engine synth
2800c96a52a7dc865f1aa44d7e410d61.en: Colliding gliders assemble the Schick engine.
2800c96a52a7dc865f1aa44d7e410d61.pt: Planadores em colisão montam o Schick engine.

0cdf4b3b02734b5216aa759a3f6677ee.name: Ship synth
0cdf4b3b02734b5216aa759a3f6677ee.pt: Colisões de planadores que produzem ships.

017950a37784cbdb39c2748a78d96c6f.name: slowpuffer2 synth
017950a37784cbdb39c2748a78d96c6f.en: Gliders collide to build slow puffer 2.
017950a37784cbdb39c2748a78d96c6f.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o slow puffer 2.

3b8d2b92414338879bac35cb3696c378.name: Snakedance synth
3b8d2b92414338879bac35cb3696c378.en: Sixteen gliders collide to form snake dance.
3b8d2b92414338879bac35cb3696c378.pt: Dezesseis planadores colidem para formar o snake dance.

0111ff2befb1b4f4b911e5f3f52fd324.name: Switchengine synth
0111ff2befb1b4f4b911e5f3f52fd324.en: Three gliders collide to create a bare switch engine, with nothing yet stabilizing it.
0111ff2befb1b4f4b911e5f3f52fd324.pt: Três planadores colidem e criam um switch engine sem nada que o estabilize.

21ece91d97a5f17bd33e8fe89f497332.name: Thunderbird synth
21ece91d97a5f17bd33e8fe89f497332.en: Just three gliders produce a thunderbird.
21ece91d97a5f17bd33e8fe89f497332.pt: Apenas três planadores produzem um thunderbird.

326451a145db2713a1586ec30fcd9412.name: Trans-beacon and table synth
326451a145db2713a1586ec30fcd9412.en: A glider collision that assembles trans-beacon and table.
326451a145db2713a1586ec30fcd9412.pt: Uma colisão de planadores que monta o trans-beacon and table.

29de338179dd8e502e6e211c0cc2017f.name: Transrotatedrbee synth
29de338179dd8e502e6e211c0cc2017f.en: Four gliders suffice to build the trans-rotated R-bee.
29de338179dd8e502e6e211c0cc2017f.pt: Quatro planadores bastam para construir o trans-rotated R-bee.

02169107b182a2e096f1fad34070d5df.name: Tumbler synth
02169107b182a2e096f1fad34070d5df.en: Two 6-glider recipes for the tumbler; the second was derived from a soup found on Catagolue.
02169107b182a2e096f1fad34070d5df.pt: Duas receitas de 6 planadores para o tumbler; a segunda foi tirada de uma sopa do Catagolue.

03c5171d859b4c26e91dc74b5ba6eda7.name: Twoblockershasslingrpentomino synth
03c5171d859b4c26e91dc74b5ba6eda7.en: Builds two blockers hassling R-pentomino, nicknamed Roseluck, from 29 gliders.
03c5171d859b4c26e91dc74b5ba6eda7.pt: Monta o two blockers hassling R-pentomino, apelidado de Roseluck, com 29 planadores.

054dfba14994c8fc0afc15c2588f6b24.name: Verylongboat synth
054dfba14994c8fc0afc15c2588f6b24.en: Several glider recipes for the very long boat.
054dfba14994c8fc0afc15c2588f6b24.pt: Várias receitas com planadores para o very long boat.

00dc74a3106a91afa326401dd8fa529b.name: Worker bee synth
00dc74a3106a91afa326401dd8fa529b.en: Gliders collide to build the worker bee, also known as lonely bee.
00dc74a3106a91afa326401dd8fa529b.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o worker bee, também chamado de lonely bee.

0eef5d4ce3fc9b39b4ef2260df7f01f3.name: c/5 line stretcher
0eef5d4ce3fc9b39b4ef2260df7f01f3.en: Stretches a line at c/5; Matthias Merzenich improved the design just a day after it was found.
0eef5d4ce3fc9b39b4ef2260df7f01f3.pt: Estica uma linha a c/5; Matthias Merzenich aprimorou o projeto apenas um dia depois de ele ser encontrado.

198f016c22e34f03ca50808244bbcaa6.name: Mosquito 1b
198f016c22e34f03ca50808244bbcaa6.en: A pattern whose population grows quadratically over time.
198f016c22e34f03ca50808244bbcaa6.pt: Um padrão cuja população cresce de forma quadrática com o tempo.

15e9dea08e99abba0379cb79c3b8a597.name: p37 reflections
15e9dea08e99abba0379cb79c3b8a597.en: Period-37 glider reflections, one sending gliders back 180 degrees and one turning them 90 degrees.
15e9dea08e99abba0379cb79c3b8a597.pt: Reflexões de planadores com período 37: uma devolve os planadores em 180 graus e a outra os desvia em 90 graus.

16540253f0597a865fd29a64a0ecc893.name: Primer
16540253f0597a865fd29a64a0ecc893.en: A prime number sieve implemented in the Game of Life.
16540253f0597a865fd29a64a0ecc893.pt: Uma peneira de números primos implementada no Jogo da Vida.

a0b6c6c23dc50d0cc0a8238d5fb89dac.name: Turing machine
a0b6c6c23dc50d0cc0a8238d5fb89dac.en: A Life construction able to carry out Turing-complete computation.
a0b6c6c23dc50d0cc0a8238d5fb89dac.pt: Uma construção no Jogo da Vida capaz de computação Turing-completa.

54703873d953bef57fcd0e264dd1424f.name: Bun
54703873d953bef57fcd0e264dd1424f.en: An induction coil. Left on its own it is one of the usual starting points of a honey farm.
54703873d953bef57fcd0e264dd1424f.pt: Uma bobina de indução. Deixada sozinha, é um dos pontos de partida mais comuns de um honey farm.

0d589375a0f8cc2fb6eb7aa7e979cc44.name: Cover
0d589375a0f8cc2fb6eb7aa7e979cc44.en: An induction coil, used for example in the scrubber; on its own it dies out after 8 generations.
0d589375a0f8cc2fb6eb7aa7e979cc44.pt: Uma bobina de indução, usada por exemplo no scrubber; sozinha, desaparece após 8 gerações.

05ea4d5048332577dd114a6e614e9f23.name: Garden of Eden 1
05ea4d5048332577dd114a6e614e9f23.en: The earliest Garden of Eden deliberately constructed: a pattern that cannot arise from any previous generation.
05ea4d5048332577dd114a6e614e9f23.pt: O primeiro Jardim do Éden construído de propósito: um padrão que não pode surgir de nenhuma geração anterior.

16a12042567c9c97afd6ddfd5ecb746d.name: Hammer
16a12042567c9c97afd6ddfd5ecb746d.en: Two LWSSs slam into the back of a third, converting it into an MWSS; this example is by Dieter Leithner.
16a12042567c9c97afd6ddfd5ecb746d.pt: Duas naves leves atingem a traseira de uma terceira e a transformam numa nave média; exemplo de Dieter Leithner.

15222dcdf64a66da4b483124780a72d3.name: Line-cutting reaction
15222dcdf64a66da4b483124780a72d3.en: LWSSs slice through an endless diagonal row of cells and leave a gap sealed at both ends. The line-mending reaction can repair it.
15222dcdf64a66da4b483124780a72d3.pt: Naves leves cortam uma linha diagonal infinita de células e deixam uma lacuna selada nas duas pontas. A line-mending reaction pode consertá-la.

5ea6cae3b4661a5f0e6a968bbefc85f8.name: Pre-block
5ea6cae3b4661a5f0e6a968bbefc85f8.en: A frequent parent of the block: one generation later it becomes one. The grin is another such parent.
5ea6cae3b4661a5f0e6a968bbefc85f8.pt: Um pai comum do bloco: uma geração depois, vira um bloco. O grin é outro padrão com esse papel.

2c261d0ee58108cc22a7b93d1c307c09.name: Shorttable
2c261d0ee58108cc22a7b93d1c307c09.en: Conway's name for the U-pentomino, one of the twelve pentominoes; it dies out quickly, within 4 generations.
2c261d0ee58108cc22a7b93d1c307c09.pt: Nome dado por Conway ao U-pentominó, um dos 12 pentominós; morre rápido, em 4 gerações.

14f09afc07b04f3df5723abb1f370b30.name: T-tetromino
14f09afc07b04f3df5723abb1f370b30.en: One of the five tetrominoes, and a common forerunner of the traffic light, which it becomes after 9 generations.
14f09afc07b04f3df5723abb1f370b30.pt: Um dos cinco tetrominós e precursor comum do traffic light, no qual se transforma após 9 gerações.

1cf20388fb4da936cd1616e611fb9d48.name: Tractor beam
1cf20388fb4da936cd1616e611fb9d48.en: A stream of LWSSs hauls a loaf toward the stream's source; Dean Hickerson used this trick to build a sawtooth.
1cf20388fb4da936cd1616e611fb9d48.pt: Um fluxo de naves leves puxa um loaf em direção à origem do fluxo; Dean Hickerson usou esse truque para construir um sawtooth.

0c66dfa70f3b9bb0ee4e90385acea27e.name: Very long house
0c66dfa70f3b9bb0ee4e90385acea27e.en: Counted among the induction coils; by itself it evolves for 6 generations before becoming stable.
0c66dfa70f3b9bb0ee4e90385acea27e.pt: Classificada como bobina de indução; sozinha, evolui por 6 gerações antes de se estabilizar.
